{
  "dataset_name": "bank_marketing",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "is_previously_contacted",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator of whether the client was previously contacted, derived from pdays.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree models can directly split on this boolean indicator to separate new prospects from existing ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays < 999, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of current campaign contacts to previous contacts, capturing the relative intensity of the current marketing effort.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "behavioral_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous interaction feature that helps trees identify over-contacted individuals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "campaign / np.maximum(previous, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "euribor_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of the 3-month euribor rate from its training set mean, indicating extreme economic conditions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows tree models to isolate periods of unusual interest rates without needing multiple splits on the raw euribor feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(euribor3m - 3.618)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_group_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucketing of age into young (<30), middle-aged (30-59), and senior (>=60) categories.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a pre-binned ordinal feature that reduces the number of splits a tree needs to capture non-linear age effects.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(age < 30, 0, np.where(age < 60, 1, 2))"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the client's financial health based on job type, marital status, education level, and existing credit (default, housing, loan).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple categorical financial indicators into a single ordinal score, simplifying the tree's decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "recent_contact_duration_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed duration of the last contact to handle the heavy-tailed distribution of call times.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "behavioral",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses extreme outliers in call duration, making it easier for tree models to find stable split points.",
      "leakage_risk": "high",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(duration)"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_rate_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between the number of employees and its historical mean, capturing macroeconomic volatility.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 250.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights periods of significant employment shifts, providing a strong non-linear signal for tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(nr.employed - 5166.9)"
    },
    {
      "name": "consumer_sentiment_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Linear combination of consumer price index and scaled consumer confidence index to represent overall consumer sentiment.",
      "value_range": [85.0, 95.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines two correlated macroeconomic indicators into a single continuous feature, reducing redundancy for tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "cons.price.idx + (cons.conf.idx / 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "campaign_fatigue_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator flagging clients who have been contacted more than 3 times during the current campaign.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "behavioral",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a direct threshold feature for tree models to penalize over-contacting without needing deep splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(campaign > 3, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "seasonality_proxy",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of the contact timing based on the month and day of the week, estimating the likelihood of reaching the client at an opportune moment.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates cyclical categorical variables into an ordinal scale of contact favorability, which trees can split on efficiently.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "pdays_decay_weight",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse decay function of days since last contact, assigning higher weights to recently contacted clients and 0 to uncontacted ones.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Transforms a highly skewed variable with a distinct missing value code (999) into a smooth continuous feature bounded between 0 and 1.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays == 999, 0.0, 1.0 / (1.0 + pdays))"
    },
    {
      "name": "socio_economic_vulnerability",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimation of the client's vulnerability to economic downturns, synthesizing age, job category, education, and current macroeconomic indicators.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a high-level interaction feature that captures complex relationships between personal demographics and the broader economy.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
